name: MODUL University Vienna
summary: Private English-language university on the Kahlenberg above Vienna: six bachelor's in management, tourism, data science and international relations.

ib.text: IB Diploma with at least 24 points, plus maths: AA or AI at 4 (SL) or 3 (HL); lower means a maths foundation course in semester 1. IB Certificates need a foundation semester and an entrance exam.

dates.label: Super Early Bird, fall entry: €2,000 off the year (yearly date)
Early Bird, fall entry: €1,000 off the year (yearly date)
Final deadline, fall entry, if you need a visa (yearly date)

programmes.name: BSc in Applied Data Science
programmes.about: Data science applied to business, services, healthcare and geographic information systems, with a bachelor's thesis and preparation for an internship, in a small private university above Vienna.

needs.note: HL at grade 3 also counts; below that you take a maths foundation course in semester 1.

programmes.selectionNote: Your documents are checked for eligibility, then a 30-minute interview on Teams about your motivation; a decision usually follows within 10 days. Earlier applications pay less.

programmes.name: BSc in Human Resources Management
programmes.about: Social and organisational psychology combined with leadership, project management, marketing and strategy, for people-focused roles in companies; includes a 900-hour internship.

needs.note: HL at grade 3 also counts; below that you take a maths foundation course in semester 1.

programmes.selectionNote: Your documents are checked for eligibility, then a 30-minute interview on Teams about your motivation; a decision usually follows within 10 days. Earlier applications pay less.

programmes.name: BSc in International Management
programmes.about: International business through a global lens: management strategy, managing multicultural teams and entrepreneurship, taught through real projects, case studies and business simulations.

needs.note: HL at grade 3 also counts; below that you take a maths foundation course in semester 1.

programmes.selectionNote: Your documents are checked for eligibility, then a 30-minute interview on Teams about your motivation; a decision usually follows within 10 days. Earlier applications pay less.

family.name: BSc in International Management
family.differs: The three-year degree, without the professional-experience part.

programmes.name: BSc in International Management with Professional Experience
programmes.about: The International Management degree with an extra seventh semester: a 900-hour internship anywhere in the world, written up in an internship report.

needs.note: HL at grade 3 also counts; below that you take a maths foundation course in semester 1.

programmes.selectionNote: Your documents are checked for eligibility, then a 30-minute interview on Teams about your motivation; a decision usually follows within 10 days. Earlier applications pay less.

family.name: BSc in International Management
family.differs: Seven semesters (210 ECTS) that include professional experience.

programmes.name: BA in International Relations and Sustainability
programmes.about: Global governance and international organisations, human rights and international law, and climate policy and sustainable development, with a 650-hour internship and applied diplomacy training.

needs.note: HL at grade 3 also counts; below that you take a maths foundation course in semester 1.

programmes.selectionNote: Your documents are checked for eligibility, then a 30-minute interview on Teams about your motivation; a decision usually follows within 10 days. Earlier applications pay less.

programmes.name: BBA in Tourism and Hospitality Management
programmes.about: Tourism and hospitality management for school-leavers with no prior hospitality training: markets, customer strategy and operations, with an internship semester and an option of two years in Hong Kong.

needs.note: HL at grade 3 also counts; below that you take a maths foundation course in semester 1.

programmes.selectionNote: Your documents are checked for eligibility, then a 30-minute interview on Teams about your motivation; a decision usually follows within 10 days. Earlier applications pay less.

programmes.name: BBA in Tourism, Hotel Management and Operations
programmes.about: Tourism and hotel management with hands-on operational training, industry internships, study trips and an optional year at The City College of New York (the New York Extension).

needs.note: HL at grade 3 also counts; below that you take a maths foundation course in semester 1.

programmes.selectionNote: Your documents are checked for eligibility, then a 30-minute interview on Teams about your motivation; a decision usually follows within 10 days. Earlier applications pay less.

notes: The earlier you apply, the lower the fee: €2,000 off the year by 15 January, €1,000 off by 15 March.
A mobility agreement with The Hong Kong Polytechnic University lets BBA and BSc students split their degree between Vienna and Hong Kong.
